subject: Re: Cloud42 partner promo: onboarding credits coordination
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloud42.io>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@cloud42.io
Date: Wed, 1 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cloud42 partner promo: onboarding credits for migration

Hi Ben / Marissa,

We kicked off the Cloud42 migration playbook yesterday and the partner success team asked whether Redwood can issue partner-funded onboarding credits for customers who sign up via our Cloud42 marketplace listing. The ask: 10,000 token credits per eligible account (good for 90 days) for the first 150 customers that complete the migration flow.

High level:
- Purpose: reduce friction & encourage early migrations from Cloud42-managed infra.
- Eligibility: Cloud42-identified accounts listed in the attached CSV (sample).
- Fulfillment: partner-triggered issuance preferred (Cloud42 submits list, Redwood credits each account programmatically or via CSV ingestion).
- Timeline: initial batch within 5 business days after we sign the partner MSA and confirm the customer list.

I attached a one-page summary and a sample customer CSV. Can you confirm the operational route and whether we need a DocuSign or internal approval ticket?

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Partner Programs, Cloud42
liam.oconnor@cloud42.io
Attachments: cloud42_sample_customers.csv (CSV stub), cloud42_promo_summary.pdf (PDF stub)

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloud42.io>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Apr 2026 14:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloud42 partner promo: onboarding credits for migration

Thanks Liam — this sounds straightforward and aligned with our partner incentives program. A couple of operational clarifications before we move to issuance:

1) Need the signed partner MSA or a redline-confirmed agreement. Can you send the DocuSign link or the executed PDF?
2) We require: partner ID, HubSpot partner account id, and the Cloud42 account IDs for each customer (email or company domain). The sample CSV is helpful; please include a canonical customer identifier.
3) Do you expect automated issuance (API) or one-off CSV ingestion? CSV is easiest for the initial run; API would be preferable for repeat batches.
4) Any special billing rules for these credits (i.e., who pays if usage exceeds credits)?

Cc'ing Monica from Partner Ops to scope the ingestion template and Vivek from Finance if we need to surface any billing notes. If you can get the signed MSA and the canonical CSV this week we can target issuance by next Tuesday.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloud42.io>, marketplace-ops@cloud42.io
Date: Thu, 2 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloud42 partner promo: onboarding credits for migration

Hi all — operational notes from Partner Ops:

- Template: I attached our CSV ingestion template (headers: partner_id, hubspot_deal_id, customer_email, customer_domain, credit_amount, expiration_date, internal_deal_note). Please populate those fields exactly.
- Approvals: We require an executed MSA on file and a short statement from Cloud42 confirming that the listed customers have opted into the migration program.
- Security: No PII other than business emails. If Cloud42 insists on company IDs only we can accept domain-based matching.
- Execution path: send the final CSV to partner-credits@redwood.com, subject line: "PartnerCredits | Cloud42 | <batch-date>". For the first run we'll do manual ingest and provide an issuance report.
- SLA: standard T+3 business days for manual ingestion. If you need T+1, highlight it and we'll queue it as expedited.

I'm attaching the CSV template and a short checklist. Liam — can you confirm whether Cloud42 will provide company domains or customer emails?

—Monica
Monica Patel
Partner Operations, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
Attachments: partner_credits_template.csv (CSV stub), promo_operational_checklist.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloud42.io>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: marketplace-ops@cloud42.io
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloud42 partner promo: onboarding credits for migration

Hi Monica / Ben,

Thanks — attached is the signed MSA (Cloud42_MSA_signed.pdf). We've filled the CSV with company_domain and customer_email where available; attached "cloud42_eligible_customers.csv" is the first batch of 45 accounts. Cloud42 confirms customers have opted in; marketplace-ops is looped in for any follow-ups.

We prefer manual ingestion for the first two batches so we can audit credit application, then move to API once flow is proven. We'd like to target issuance by next Tuesday (6 Apr). If that timeline is tight, please let us know and we'll adjust.

Files attached: Cloud42_MSA_signed.pdf, cloud42_eligible_customers.csv

Best,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Partner Programs, Cloud42
liam.oconnor@cloud42.io

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloud42.io>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cloud42 partner promo: onboarding credits coordination — issuance complete

Liam / Cloud42 team —

Issuance update: we ingested the CSV you provided and issued 10,000-token credits to the 45 accounts in batch #1. Attached is the onboarding_credits_issuance_report.csv showing account identifiers, issuance timestamps, and internal reference ids.

Notes:
- Manual ingestion SLA: T+3 met.
- Expiration: credits set to expire 2026-07-05 as requested (90 days).
- Tracking: HubSpot deal link for this partner promotion: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567 (internal).
- Next steps: please provide batch #2 CSV when ready; if you want automated API issuance we can start scoping that integration next week (API keys/partner auth required).

Cc'ing Vivek for finance visibility on partner credit burn reporting and Marissa for customer success handoff.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Attachments: onboarding_credits_issuance_report.csv (CSV stub)
